sources.used_for: The API supports passive raw exact-length receive with timeout, a bounded close/2 timeout, explicit trusted roots, SNI and HTTPS hostname matching. The helper selects these interfaces and refuses malformed or incomplete HTTP framing.
cacerts_get loads the operating system trusted roots and fails if none are available; the HTTPS hostname match function is documented.
